status: Native read-only draft health simulation implemented and locally tested; not a universal automation simulator or F2/C-G closure.
implementation: A dedicated authorized POST preview uses a fresh real Context, current scoped customer data and CustomerSignals/HealthScore; it never invokes Processor, playbooks, delivery or configuration saves.

The draft is an unsaved update instance with native identity, expected version and all native validations. Product/segment/company/unit/account precedence is retained through the original Context.configuration method.

The response explicitly identifies simulation and no business writes, with current/proposed score, coverage/factors/evidence and effective scope/version. A draft that is not effective is visibly identified.

A separate section below the native editor selects real scoped paginated customers, compares results, aborts old requests and clears evidence when identity, permissions, draft or selected customer changes. No simulated save is emitted.

tests_non_additive.label: health-preview-native01
tests_non_additive.note: Draft initially used a new model identity; native scope uniqueness correctly rejected updating an existing scope. Fixed by retaining the original native identity in a separate unsaved instance; uniqueness was not disabled.

tests_non_additive.label: health-preview-native-final
tests_non_additive.note: Five API cases including no configuration/version/snapshot/action/audit/job writes, native malformed-input rejection, account/unit isolation, plus six existing scope-precedence cases.

tests_non_additive.label: health-preview-ui01
tests_non_additive.note: Four new workflow cases plus three native configuration form regressions; Vue mocks, not Chrome.
